SELECT 
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NBILLNO", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NCODE", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NNET_AMOUNT", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO", "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."CB", "MILK_SUPPLIER"."VNAME", "MILK_SUPPLIER"."NACNO", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."DSTART_DATE", "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."DEND_DATE"
FROM
    "BGK"."MILK_BILL_HEADER" "MILK_BILL_HEADER",
    "BGK"."MILK_SUPPLIER" "MILK_SUPPLIER",
    "BGK"."MILK_FORTNIGHT" "MILK_FORTNIGHT"
WHERE
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NCODE" = "MILK_SUPPLIER"."NCODE" AND
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" = "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."NFORTNO" AND
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" = "MILK_FORTNIGHT"."VYEAR_CODE"
ORDER BY
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."VYEAR_CODE" ASC,
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NFORTNO" ASC,
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NBILLNO" ASC,
    "MILK_BILL_HEADER"."NCODE" ASC
